youtube_title: Phone Fell on the Metro Track: Jump Down or Call Staff? Brave vs Normal #15 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL - WHO'S RIGHT? #15. Your phone falls on the metro track. Brave wants to jump down and grab it. Normal tells the metro staff. Comment B or N!
Answer: NORMAL. Metro rules say never step onto the track or try to pick up belongings that fall there - contact metro staff. Many lines have a 750 V third rail and a train can come any second. Jumping down can get you fined and stops the whole line.
Sources: Lucknow Metro and Kochi Metro passenger do's and don'ts; Deccan Herald report on a Bengaluru metro track incident.
